spans.text: The offensive assault on Architect's outpost begins.
You can't possibly threaten me with attacks that are barely a scratch.
What's the point in this corpse run?!
M4A1, the structure of Architect's command post has been thoroughly mapped out.
But SAA still needs some time to set things up.
I know. I'll buy time for her.
We may be outnumbered, but we have ample supplies and can keep this going for a long time.
Tell them not to rush and remain vigilant at all times!
Can we though? Judging by Architect's character, she probably won't put up with our harassment for long...
I'm not too sure about that. Architect...seems a bit different than how she comes off in our data.
I also need some time to feel out the way she acts and come up with corresponding tactics.
Perhaps then...we can deal with them all - Architect...as well as the Sangvis AI core.
